# ── What we do ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Description: Compliance365 is an Australian compliance consultancy helping
mid-market and growth-stage organisations achieve certification and improve
security posture using tools they already own — primarily Microsoft 365,
SharePoint, Power Automate, and Azure — rather than expensive GRC platforms.
We deliver ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, Essential Eight, SOC 2, DISP/ISM/IRAP,
and NIST CSF 2.0 engagements, typically completing certification in 10–16 weeks.

# ── Expertise areas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
Expertise:
  - ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Information Security Management Systems)
  - ISO/IEC 27701:2019 (Privacy Information Management Systems)
  - ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AI Management Systems / AI Governance)
  - ASD Essential Eight (Maturity Level 1, 2, 3)
  - SOC 2 Type I and Type II
  - DISP (Defence Industry Security Program)
  - ISM (Australian Government Information Security Manual)
  - IRAP (Infosec Registered Assessors Program readiness)
  - NIST CSF 2.0
  - Australian Privacy Act 1988 (APP compliance)
  - Microsoft 365 compliance implementation (Purview, Defender, Sentinel)
